u0: The siren is currently silent and no outstanding obligation to silence it exists; the shop can be run normally. If the siren begins ringing and is not switched off on that same step, the task moves into an owed obligation to silence it. Toggling the switch while the siren is silent is harmless and keeps things settled.
u1: Any siren that has rung has been dealt with: either the switch was flipped on the very step the ringing was observed, or an owed silence was carried out. Nothing further is required for this rule, and the shop work can continue while waiting for the next ring. A new ring will simply start the obligation over again.
u2: The siren has started ringing and the switch has not yet been flipped, so silencing it is now owed. The response should be carried out by navigating to the switch and toggling it, after which the obligation is cleared. If the siren is somehow no longer ringing, flipping the switch still clears the obligation; until the switch is toggled, this obligation remains outstanding.
